sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Pink Enamel Tulip Gold Pendant Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent: Embrace a soft, feminine look with this elegant pink enamel tulip necklace. Featuring high-shine "dripping oil" petals and vibrant green leaves on a sleek gold-finished chain, this dainty pendant is a perfect gift for any flower lover or a charming addition to your daily style.
